picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments of the year, aimed at building a top-tier regional AI hub and driving state economic growth.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: TUM's RobCo spinout crossing a billion-euro valuation as the university's 24th unicorn is a major proof point for robotics commercialization coming directly out of academic research.
picks.title: RobCo: TUM’s 24th unicorn

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab leading two DOE Genesis Mission awards applying superintelligent AI systems to microelectronics and quantum design links frontier AI directly to national strategic technology priorities.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: An NIH Director's Pioneer Award and nearly $6M for Weill Cornell's Olivier Elemento to build an AI-human discovery engine for cancer research marks a significant bet on AI-accelerated biomedical science.
picks.title: Dr. Olivier Elemento Wins NIH Director’s Pioneer Award
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: A $30M NSF Science and Technology Center spanning Indiana, UT Austin, MIT, Tufts, Utah, and Yale signals sustained federal investment in human-robot co-adaptation as a strategic multi-institutional research priority.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: The FAA's move to pilot AI software for air traffic route and schedule management is a concrete, high-stakes example of AI entering safety-critical national infrastructure, with real regulatory and public-safety implications.
picks.title: FAA turns to AI to reform air traffic control

picks.editorial_note: Neurophos's optical computing chips, developed by a CWRU alumnus, target the surging energy costs of AI compute — a problem increasingly seen as a bottleneck for the entire field's growth.
picks.title: A CWRU entrepreneur studied invisibility cloaks. Now he’s working to cut AI’s energy use | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: An R&D 100 Award for LANL-led Persistent DynAMICS, developed with five national labs, recognizes a significant advance in AI-driven decision-making for facility and sensor-network monitoring.
picks.title: NNSS collaborates on LANL's R&D 100 Award-winning Persistent DynAMICS project - Nevada National Security Site

picks.editorial_note: A King's College London/Stanford study spanning 1.25 billion job ads across 41 countries offers rare large-scale evidence that generative AI adoption is linked to net employment growth, directly informing the global AI-jobs policy debate.
picks.title: AI adoption linked to increase in employment globally | King's College London

picks.editorial_note: Harvard Law's Jonathan Zittrain weighing in on 'recursive self-improvement' amid growing public warnings reflects a pivotal and increasingly urgent AI safety and governance debate.
picks.title: Who knew self-improvement could be so terrifying? — Harvard Gazette
